verdict.rationale: Stripe's refunds docs say you can refund all or part of a payment after it succeeds, and that refunds can be issued through either the Refunds API or the Dashboard. Supporting docs add viewing refunded payments in the Dashboard and no-code refunds for Payment Links. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and explicit confirmation that partial amounts specifically are supported in the Dashboard flow rather than only implied by combining the two statements.
